purpose: Teach: 至極/入団/簡易裁判所/身動き/座標/品番/邦題/体勢

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本件の解決は至極順調ですね
lines.en: The police department has been handling this case extremely smoothly.
lines.style: Respectful observation delivered with genuine admiration. Warm, slightly formal tone. Steady pace, confident. Light emphasis on 'extremely.' A compliment that shows he's been paying attention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、若手警察官の入団式にもご出席されますね
lines.en: And you'll be attending the ceremony for the new officers too, I hear.
lines.style: Conversational, slightly curious. Warm and knowing — like he's acknowledging something admirable without making it awkward. Relaxed pace, genuine interest underneath the surface.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、軽微な事件は簡易裁判所で扱われますね
lines.en: Minor cases are handled by summary court, aren't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. Not quite a question despite the rising particle. Acknowledging the system with understated approval. Soft, measured pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の身動きが取れない状況を作られますね
lines.en: You've really managed to restrict the suspect's movements, haven't you.
lines.style: Appreciative recognition. Calm, steady tone with quiet respect. Slight pause before 'movements' — acknowledging the difficulty of what was done. Not over-praising, just straightforward acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場の座標を正確に記録されますね
lines.en: The exact coordinates from the scene are recorded with precision.
lines.style: Factual observation with underlying appreciation. Clear, professional tone. Steady pace. A nod to competence without sounding like a lecture. Genuinely impressed by the attention to detail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の品番を厳密に管理されますね
lines.en: You keep strict control over the inventory of confiscated items.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. Genuine respect for the protocol and discipline. Even pace, professional but warm. Recognition of meticulous work done without fanfare.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、海外手配書の邦題化もされますね
lines.en: Even the international wanted notices get translated and adapted here.
lines.style: Light note of admiration. Slightly wondering tone — recognizing the breadth of work being done. Relaxed but genuinely impressed. A small smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、応援を呼ぶ体勢を整えられてますね
lines.en: And you've got the whole backup system ready to go whenever you need it.
lines.style: Closer, more familiar. Slight shift to warmer, more personal acknowledgment. Conversational and approving. A nod to preparedness and professionalism, friend-to-colleague.
